S02 E11 — Pups Leave Marshall Home Alone; Pups Save the Deer
Marshall must head out for a rescue on his own when Katie calls with an emergency; the PAW Patrol must rescue a family of deer who are stuck on the slippery ice.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E01 — Pups Save the Jungle Penguins; Pups Save a Freighter
When an ice floe carrying three penguins lands in the jungle, the pups must get the birds back to their frosty home; Daring Danny is locked out of the lighthouse Turbot left him to look after, with a freighter headed his way.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S01 E08 — Pups Pit Crew; Pups Fight Fire
Ryder and the PAW Patrol must rescue Alex when he takes off on his new super trike; Marshall proves he is a true hero when he stops during a competition to put out a fire on the beach.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E02 — Pups Save the Space Alien; Pups Save a Flying Frog
The PAW Patrol helps an extra-terrestrial after his spaceship crash lands at Farmer Yumi's place; the Pups come to the rescue when Smiley the frog jumps into Skye's helicopter.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S01 E05 — Pup Pup Goose; Pup Pup and Away
Marshall's new gosling friend gets lost; the PAW Patrol must rescue the mayor from a hot air balloon.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E05 — Pups Save the Mustache; Pups Save the Funhouse
The Pups must help to find Mayor Humdinger's mustache after he accidentally shaves it off; after a carnival train gets stuck in a tunnel, it results in a mountainside funhouse-style wild ride.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E22 — Pups Save a Floundering Francois; Pups Save the Pop-Up Penguins
Cap'n Turbot and his cousin Francois are watching white whales in Adventure Bay when their boat hits a rock and starts to sink; the PAW Patrol must track down some loose penguins and help them return to the land of ice and snow.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
Best of Everest
Everest lends a hand; an ice storm causes trouble; the pups rescue a family of deer; Cali becomes a stowaway; Jake and Everest are excited about the snowboard competition; Alex and Mr. Porter get into an accident; a storm causes Skye to crash-land.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E25 — Skye's Road Trip Rescue
Skye, Liberty and Everest take off on a road trip to Yellowstone National Park and need to use their mini-rescue rides to save a bunch of baby animals.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E25 — Ultimate Rescue: Pups Save a Runaway Stargazer
A comet is coming, and the PAW Patrol gets to work building a giant observatory; when the observatory starts rolling out of control, Rubble and the pups need to rebuild everything it has destroyed.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E23 — Pups Save a Frozen Camp-Out; Pups Save the Fizzy Pickles
A freak snowstorm hits while Alex and Mr. Porter are camping on a tropical island; Mr. Porter is delivering his fizzy pickles to people around town when a bumpy road shakes up the deliveries and causes the pickle juice to spill.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S01 E14 — Pups Save the Bay; Pups Save a Goodway
Ryder and the PAW Patrol clean up an oil spill in the water near Adventure Bay; the PAW Patrol must help Mayor Goodway get a statue from the bottom of the bay.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S01 E03 — Pups and the Kitty-tastrophe; Pups Save a Train
Ryder and the PAW Patrol rescue a lost kitty from the bay; Ryder, Rubble and Rocky must help free Katie and Cali's train from a rockslide.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E25 — Skye's Road Trip Rescue
Skye, Liberty and Everest take off on a road trip to Yellowstone National Park and need to use their mini-rescue rides to save a bunch of baby animals.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E19 — Pups Save Queen Cluck-Cluck; Pups Save a Desert Flounder
Mayor Goodway dreams she's traveled to the mysterious Cluck Cluck Island, a very strange land where Chickaletta is royalty; Traveling Travis' balloon gets caught on the Flounder.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S12 E10 — Pups Save a Big Brother; Pups Save a Giant Baby
Farmer Yumi dreams about what her new baby will be like when she's bigger.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S12 E07 — Search and Rescue: Pups Help the Chickens Cross the Road; Search and Rescue: Pups Save a Lost Ryder
Chickaletta's family is scattered around town, causing traffic jams; the Safety and Rescue Pups have to help the chickens cross the road; Chase leads a mission to rescue a lost Ryder which involves clues, tools and Chewington.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E13 — Pups Save a Show Jumper; Pups Save the Salmon
Winnie Winnington goes looking for a frog to enter in a frog-jumping contest and ends up needing to be rescued in a swamp; the pups try to help salmon get to an ocean and also need to rescue Alex.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E09 — A Big Splash!
On the Shimmy-Shimmy Islands, everyone's preparing for Queen Zooli's dance party, but each time they practice, a huge wave splashes them.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E15 — Bubble Medics to the Rescue!
In Ancient Greece, paramedics Zooli and Gil get a call for help from Nonny, so they fly toward him in their chariot ambulance; on the way, they're pursued by a Cyclops.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E12 — The Oyster Bunny!
The Guppies must follow an egg trail to find the mysterious Oyster Bunny.

title: Team Umizoomi
description:
S01 E07 — The Milk Out
It's breakfast time at headquarters, but Milli, Geo and Bot realize they're out of milk; kids from all over the town call in with the same problem.

title: Team Umizoomi
description:
S04 E12 — Umi Ninjas
Milli, Geo and Bot must use their ninja skills to retrieve their stolen ninja trophy.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E09 — Pups Save an Ace; Pups Save a Wedding
Skye and the Pups must save a stunt pilot and her plane; the Pups help Farmer Yumi prepare for her wedding day.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E12 — Pups Save a School Bus; Pups Save the Songbirds
Rocky helps repair the tires on the Adventure Bay school bus; Ryder and Chase search for missing songbirds.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E17 — Mighty Pups Stop the Mighty Queen; Mighty Pups Stop the Hiccups
The Mighty Pups must stop Sweetie from using her new powers to take over Adventure Bay; Mighty Nano gets the hiccups, so it's up to Liberty and the Mighty Pups to find a cure.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S04 E04 — The Crew Builds a Pirate Ship Café; The Crew Builds a Sierra Sparkle Experience
When Café Carl's pirate-themed restaurant gets caught in rough waters, the pups set sail with a new construction solution; Sierra Sparkle calls in help from Rubble & Crew to build a special experience for all her fans in Builder Cove.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S02 E04 — The Crew Builds a Library Tunnel; The Crew Builds a Super Snack Dispenser
Rubble and Crew's favorite book series has new additions; the pups have a surprise just for Rubble, a snack dispenser.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E11 — Pups Save the Polar Bears; A Pup in Sheep's Clothing
The pups fly to the Arctic in order to rescue lost polar bear cubs; the Patrol needs to find lost sheep and learn who has been making holes in a fence.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E04 — Pups Save the Honey; Pups Save Mayor Goodway's Purse
Yumi's Yummy Honey is all the buzz when it -- and her beehive -- go missing from her farm; Mayor Goodway's purse disappears, along with its precious cargo, Chickaletta.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E19 — Hum-Patrol to the Rescue!; Pups Save Morning Mountain Yoga
When Adventure Bay holds a raffle, a pair of nest-building seagulls snatch the winning prize; a rockslide leaves Mayor Goodway, Farmer Yumi and Garby stranded on the side of a mountain.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S01 E20 — Pups Go All Monkey; Pups Save a Hoot
An escaped monkey leads the PAW Patrol on a chase through Adventure Bay; the PAW Patrol saves a baby owl and reunites him with his mother.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E17 — Pups Save a Space Rock; Pups Save a Good Mayor
Everest, the Turbots and a Space Rock get trapped in a cave; when Mayor Goodway goes missing, Mayor Humdinger causes havoc in Adventure Bay.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E26 — Pups Save Their Floating Friends; Pups Save a Satellite
Ryder and the pups must repair the aliens' spaceship and get everyone back to Earth; when a satellite begins to fall toward Adventure Bay, the PAW Patrol have to fix it before it crashes.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Igloo; Clouds; Mr Bull Digs Up the River; Little Swift
It's a snowy day, and Peppa's family build a snowman and an igloo; Mummy, Daddy, Peppa, and George go to the seaside; Grandpa Pig takes Peppa and George for a day on his boat; Peppa and her family take a sick Swift to the vet.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Long Train Journey; Madame Gazelle's House; Suzy Goes Away; Tiny Land; Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard
Daddy Pig receives a letter saying he must go away on business to test some very important concrete; Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy Pig go to visit Madame Gazelle and her wonky house.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Best Friend; Camping; The Playground; The School Fete; Mummy Pig's Birthday
Peppa's friend comes over to play; Peppa and her family go camping; Peppa and George go to the playground; Peppa and her family go to the school fête; the family celebrates Mummy Pig's birthday.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Stone Age Granny; Space Adventure!; Fire Station Practice; Science Museum; Mr. Bull the Teacher
Granny and her friends' historical reenactment society are being cave people today; Peppa and George are reenacting the Apollo moon landing.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S02 E08 — A Tooth on the Looth!
Deema has a loose tooth; the Guppies learn about keeping a healthy smile.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E05 — Ocean Patrol!
The Ocean Patrol tries to stop Windy Pete when he sails around the world and blasts tropical climates with snow.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E01 — Get Ready for School!
Oona's friend is worried about his first day of school; the guppies reveal that school is a great place to learn, play and meet new friends.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S04 E03 — The New Doghouse!
When an accident destroys Bubble Puppy's doghouse, the Guppies team up with the entire neighborhood to build Bubble Puppy's dream home.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E13 — The Kingdom of Laughs-a-Lot!
Jesters Goby and Gil arrive in the Kingdom of NeverLaugh, where King Grumpfish decrees that he'll outlaw laughter if no one can make him laugh before sundown.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E10 — Dragons N' Roses!
When Petunia the Dragon moves to the Kingdom of Flowers, everyone is afraid of her fearsome roar except for Zooli, who befriends Petunia and shows her friends how lovable Petunia really is.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E14 — Come to Your Senses!
When Nonny breaks his glasses, he must use his other senses to reach the glasses store.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E22 — Zooli's New Pet!
Excited that Zooli is getting a new pet, the Guppies try to guess what kind of animal it is; Zooli loves many creatures, so her new pet could be anything in the animal kingdom.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E05 — Ducks in a Row
Nonnie must figure out how to lead the marching band when a duck gets in its way.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E24 — The Three Guppeteers!
When a Gargoyle steals all the gifts and decorations for Countess Molly's surprise party, the French villagers call in the Three Guppeteers.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E20 — Pups Save the Mail; Pups Save a Frog Mayor
When the postman's truck gets stuck in the mud, the mail is stuck in a tree; Mayor Goodway turns into a frog.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E03 — Pups Save a Playful Dragon; Pups Save the Critters
Buddy, the playful dragon from one of Alex's books, gets out and the pups need to get him back; Francois' trailer comes unhooked and all of his critters get loose.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S02 E08 — The Crew Builds Charger a Super Bed; The Crew Builds a Super Squirrely Whirly Playground
Charger has got too much energy to sleep; Rubble and Crew know there's always a construction solution; Rubble and the pups build Mix, Motor, Lucas, and Lily a Super Squirrely Whirly playdate.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S05 E03 — The Crew Builds A Rock-Climbing Wall; The Crew Builds A Giant Octo-Sandbox
Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove where they live, play and build whatever the community needs.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E02 — Pups Save Big Paw; Pups Save a Hum-Mover
When an ancient relic goes missing from Carlos' archaeological dig, Tracker and Skye must track down the creature that may have taken it; Mayor Humdinger pretends to break his toe to win a race.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E10 — Pups Save a Talent Show; Pups Save the Corn Roast
The Pups help out the mayor in the Adventure Bay Talent Show; when Chickaletta gets trapped in a corn field maze, the PAW Patrol must come to the rescue.
